title: Entries in the power rows
statement: Let $k,n$ be positive integers with $k\le n$, put $d=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$, and let $x_j$ be the binary vector of length $d$ assigned to column $j$ by the enumeration of binary vectors. For $0\le q<k-1$, $0\le i<d$, and $0\le j<n$, the matrix entry in the row indexed by $(q,i)$ and column $j$ is the $i$th binary coefficient of $x_j^{q+1}$, computed modulo the chosen irreducible binary polynomial of degree $d$.
